summary_1line: During the night battle, the Rakshasa Alayudha joins Duryodhana seeking revenge on Bhima while Karna continues battling the illusion-wielding Ghatotkacha.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ghatotkacha multiplies himself in the night sky as phantom beasts—lions, tigers, snakes with fiery tongues—swarm toward Karna’s chariot.
Karna stands firm in his chariot, loosing blazing arrows that pierce and dispel a horde of demonic illusions rushing to devour him.
The giant Rakshasa Alayudha rides a massive chariot pulled by grotesque flesh‑eating steeds as ravens circle above his blazing standard.
